AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Agroforestry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
